hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q -- '--no-verify'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Do not skip verification hooks. Fix the underlying issue or document the blocker."}'; exit 2; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'apps/frontend/src/.*\.(ts|tsx)$'; then echo 'Reminder: frontend user-facing text must use i18n keys in en/fr locale files.'; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'providers|runtime|provider_smoke'; then echo 'Reminder: provider changes need capability-level tests or provider smoke evidence.'; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'plugins|plugin\.json'; then echo 'Reminder: plugin changes need manifest, permission, and isolation checks.'; fi
